brief: The canvas displays a detailed, futuristic spaceship control panel composed of various toggle switches, large buttons, and glowing readouts. Many of the inactive switches are illuminated with a deep, noticeable red glow. When the user clicks the correct sequence of buttons or activates a specific switch, the central windscreen area dramatically shifts, replacing the current view with a vibrant, streaking representation of the ship entering hyperspace. The overall interaction is focused on direct input to trigger a major visual state change.

statement: This sketch creates a futuristic spaceship control panel with toggle switches, buttons, and a central windscreen display. The interface features deep red glowing switches that users can toggle on and off, along with blue-lit buttons. When the user clicks the center of the screen, it triggers a dramatic hyperspace transition effect where streaking light trails fill the screen, creating a sense of rapid space travel. The design focuses on clear visual feedback for interactions while maintaining a still state when idle, satisfying the requirements for both interaction and static display behavior.
